description.value: Cascade Falls Regional Park is a Fraser Valley Regional District park located near Deroche, offering access to a scenic waterfall in the mountains east of Mission. Operated by a regional government body, it sits along Ridgeview Road and draws visitors into the forested terrain of the lower Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists riding the corridor between Mission and Harrison Hot Springs would find this a worthwhile natural detour.
